title: Zesty Uruguayan Chicken Salad
description: A fresh, light keto-friendly salad featuring aromatic green cardamom and a citrusherb dressing that showcases the flavors of Uruguay.
instructions: In a bowl whisk together 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, 1 tsp ground coriander, crushed 2 green cardamom pods, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tbsp chopped cilantro, and 1 tbsp chopped parsley to create a bright marination sauce.
Pat the chicken breasts dry and coat them evenly with the marination mixture. Let sit for 10 minutes to absorb flavors.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium‑high heat. Add a splash of olive oil and cook the chicken for 6–7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board, tent with foil, and rest for 5 minutes. Then slice into strips.

While the chicken rests, whisk together 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp lime juice, and 1 tbsp toasted sunflower seeds to make a zesty dressing.
In a large bowl toss 2 cups mixed greens, ¼ cup red onion slices, and 1 diced avocado until coated with the dressing.
Top the greens with the sliced chicken, then sprinkle with the remaining chopped cilantro and parsley.
Serve immediately for a fresh, keto‑friendly lunch that highlights Uruguayan flavor.
